description.en: A fossil jointed shoot bears broad paired leaf sheaths.
description.zh: 化石分节枝条带宽大成对叶鞘。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Schizoneura gondwanensis, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Schizoneura gondwanensis 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Fused sheath blades make flat opposite fans rather than the existing horsetail's open needle whorls.
distinctness.zh: 愈合叶鞘形成相对扁叶扇，而非现有木贼疏开针叶轮。

modeling_brief.en: Create a shallow specimen relief with clear nodes and split sheath outlines; avoid inventing the full plant base.
modeling_brief.zh: 制作浅浮雕标本，突出节及分裂叶鞘轮廓，不臆造完整植株基部。

uncertainty: Detached shoot specimen; whole growth habit is not asserted.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: Sphenophytes laboratory
sources.supports: Calamites and Schizoneura fossils with documented periods and organs.
